No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. Three successive states of the same Sun retain equal underlying 24 mm discs, with the rising and setting discs partly hidden below a single horizon and the culminating disc above. Horizon occlusion is reduced to a 2 mm centre offset to retain readable cap areas. Two separated qualitative apparent-motion arcs retain clear halos. This is the selected nonpolar, south-facing observer convention: east left, west right. It is not three simultaneous suns, a calibrated altitude/time diagram or a physical orbit around Earth.", "canvas_mm": [170, 130]}, "teaching": "Three successive states of the same Sun retain equal underlying 24 mm discs, with the rising and setting discs partly hidden below a single horizon and the culminating disc above. This is the selected nonpolar, south-facing observer convention: east left, west right. It is not three simultaneous suns, a calibrated altitude/time diagram or a physical orbit around Earth.
